name: Windows — Registry Persistence: IFEO / Winlogon / AppInit
description:
Attacker objective
Persist or hijack execution by writing a boot/logon or image-hijack registry value — Image File Execution Options debugger, Winlogon Shell/Userinit, or AppInit_DLLs.

Attack logic
Setting an IFEO Debugger launches attacker code whenever a target program runs; changing Winlogon Shell/Userinit or AppInit_DLLs loads attacker code at logon or into processes. These keys are rarely modified legitimately.

Why this detection works
Registry-modification auditing records the key path and value name; scoping to the specific persistence values isolates the technique.

False positives
A debugging tool that legitimately sets an IFEO Debugger, or a management agent modifying Userinit (rare).

Tuning
Allowlist verified management tooling; investigate any unexpected write to these values.

Required telemetry
Sysmon Event ID 13 (registry.path, registry.value). Covers hosts running Sysmon.
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Identify the host and the value written (Debugger / Shell / Userinit / AppInit_DLLs) and its data.
2. If the data points to an attacker binary/script, remove it and investigate the writing process and user.
false_positives: A debugging tool that legitimately sets an IFEO Debugger, or a management agent modifying Userinit (rare).
query: event.code:"13" and ((registry.path:"*Image File Execution Options*" and registry.value:("Debugger" or "GlobalFlag")) or registry.value:"AppInit_DLLs" or (registry.path:"*Winlogon*" and registry.value:("Shell" or "Userinit" or "Notify")))
